violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Per the PIC at time of inspection, the Licensed Food Safety Manager listed for establishment at time of Opening is no longer on site. Owner is to ensure a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety is registered with the RIDOH CFP as the Licensed Food Safety Manager for the location. Application provided at the time of inspection. Per the PIC, application is filled and to be submitted. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Per the PIC at time of inspection, the Licensed Food Safety Manager listed for establishment at time of Opening is no longer on site. Owner is to ensure a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety is registered with the RIDOH CFP as the Licensed Food Safety Manager for the location. Application provided at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Cooling methods for the following food items in the Prepared Foods Display Coolers were observed in need of adjustment: - Recently prepped Chicken Salad was observed cooling at 48 degrees Fahrenheit - Scalloped Potatoes were observed cooling at 47 degrees Fahrenheit - Lasagna was observed cooling at 77 degrees Fahrenheit. Prepared foods are to be properly cooled in the walk-in cooler prior to be placed in the display cold hold equipment. Food items were moved to the walk-in freezer for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

The double doors adjacent to the deli/meat counter area were observed to be not tight fitting (the outside garage doors were left open during inspection). If garage doors are left open for extended periods of time, the outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

At the time of inspection, the 3 Door Reach-In Freezer on the freezer aisle was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 41-56 degrees Fahrenheit with several food items observed thawed. Thawed food items were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection, and recently stocked/frozen items were m oved to the walk-in cooler for proper freezer storage. 3 Door Freezer Unit is not to be used for Frozen/TCS Food storage until properly adjusted/repaired. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Food items repackaged in the food establishment are lacking proper labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients and allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. (Proper label list of ingredients is available and on hand. Per the PIC, final label configuration with label machine is being completed. Test label observed at time of inspection.) New Violation. Correct By: 03/11/2026

The wall in the area of the prep table across from the walk-in cooler are constructed of painted concrete block and the area above is open to uncovered ceiling. The wall material is not smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and a ceiling is to be provided for the prep area. Materials for wall/ceiling surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. No prep is to be done at this table until proper surfaces are applied to the wall and ceiling behind/above the prep table. (All prep to be completed in the prep room adjacent to the deli area.) Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/11/2026

Several areas of wall/ceiling coverings in the prep room and at the cooking/dishwashing areas were observed to need repair/adjustment... - wall and ceiling covering (FRP board) joints and corners observed with gaps - wall board over and behind ovens in need of resealing - exposed wood at dish area in need of resealing The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/31/2026

Several food items in the Open-Air Wall Cooler were observed held at 42-44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC to ensure food items are stored further back on shelving into the cold hold zones to ensure proper cold holding of TCS Foods is maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2026

Ambient air TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES that are scaled in Celsius and Fahrenheit shall be designed to be easily readable and accurate to ±1.5°C in the intended range of use. Internal thermometer in the walk-in cooler was properly showing accurate temperature at time of inspection. Thermometer to be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2026

Food items repackaged in the food establishment are lacking proper labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients and allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 03/04/2026

The back prep table area is lacking a proper ceiling or covered ceiling to prevent possible contamination of the prep surfaces and foods at times of prep. All prep is to be completed in the prep room adjacent to the deli until a proper ceiling is provided. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2026
Food items were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2026
Boxes of Single-Use items were observed stored on the floor in the back storage area. Single-use items are to be stored at least 6 inches off the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2026

The open-air wall cooler was observed not maintaining proper ambient temperature for cold holding of Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods (random spots in refrigeration observed at 42-44 degrees Fahrenheit). Unit is to be serviced/repaired to ensure proper cold holding of TCS Foods at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less. New Violation. Correct By: 03/04/2026

The wall in the area of the prep table across from the walk-in cooler are constructed of painted concrete block. This material is not smooth, durable, easily cleanable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. No prep is to be done at this table until proper surfaces are applied to the wall behind the prep table. (All prep to be completed in the prep room adjacent to the deli area.) New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2026

Several areas of wall/ceiling coverings in the prep room and at the cooking/dishwashing areas were observed to need repair/adjustment... - wall and ceiling covering board joints and corners observed with gaps - wall board over and behind ovens in need of resealing - exposed wood at dish area in need of resealing The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 03/18/2026
